response.sql: SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions oe JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp WHERE CAST(oe.expirespot AS TEXT) >= '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND CAST(oe.expirespot AS TEXT) <= '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY u.acctscope ORDER BY u.acctscope;
